create_L1Loss: create an L1Loss module to measure mean absolute error between input and target tensors
create_CrossEntropyLoss: create a CrossEntropyLoss module for multi-class classification with optional class weights and label smoothing
create_BCEWithLogitsLoss: create a BCEWithLogitsLoss module combining sigmoid and binary cross entropy for numerically stable binary classification
create_TripletMarginLoss: create a TripletMarginLoss module to measure triplet loss for learning embeddings with anchor positive negative pairs
create_CTCLoss: create a CTCLoss module for connectionist temporal classification between unsegmented sequences and target sequences
